title: Collision Capsule
text: Create capsule collision geometry, 3 inputs, 2 outputs; {Enable Runtime Input Dimensions Error} sets the validation of collision capsule dimensions and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Radius
ports.summary: Radius of spherical ends of capsule scalar

ports.name: Length
ports.summary: Length of central line segment of capsule scalar

ports.name: ExitFlag
ports.summary: Validity of collision capsule dimensions scalar

params.name: Enable Runtime Input Dimensions Error
params.values: Validation of collision capsule dimensions on (default) | off

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution
